summary: S&P Global Inc. filed an 8-K announcing Board approval of the separation of its Mobility division via a pro rata spin-off of 100% of Mobility Global Inc. common stock to shareholders. Each holder of record on June 15, 2026 will receive one Mobility Global share per S&P Global share held. The distribution is expected effective July 1, 2026, with S&P Global retaining no ownership interest. The spin-off is subject to the effectiveness of Mobility Global's Form 10 registration statement and Board discretion. This is a tax-free spin-off creating a standalone public company. Watch for final SEC clearance of the Form 10 and the distribution date.
